svg.text: Carbon Engine — High-Performance On-Device ESG/BRSR System Architecture
Air-Gapped Native C++20 | llama.cpp (CUDA/CPU) | FAISS Vector Search | SQLite WAL | Qt 6 Quick Desktop Client
• Full ON DELETE CASCADE for report isolation
• Sub-second index rebuild from SQLite BLOBs
1. Locality Window Check (Chunk ID ± 2 on same page)
• Caches: FY, CIN, Turnover, Headcount, Net Worth
• Eliminates redundant LLM calls across principles
• 12 Canonical SEBI Statutory Groups (A, B, P1-P9, Core)
• KV Cache reuse across section generation
• VS Code Dark Modern Theme Palette
• RightPanel: Hardware status & live activity log
• 2-Column responsive form grid for scalar numbers
• Dark styled text inputs with focus highlighting
• Dynamic [+ Add Row] and [✕ Delete] controls
• Eliminates raw JSON editing for consultants
